decisions.finding: Transient read prevents completion / deletion before reservation consume
decisions.reason: finishJourneyEvidenceReservation reads saved reservation directly and compares the explicitly supplied run id; it never calls journeyReservation after deletion. Executed interrupted-report acceptance/export tests and native full-run tests finish successfully, including all-unavailable timeout case.

decisions.finding: Validated duplicate IDs evade uniqueness check
decisions.reason: Set over validated IDs is exactly the correct effective-identity uniqueness test. Equal normalized IDs cannot survive its length comparison. runtimeIdentifier rejects unsupported raw forms.

independentFixes.issue: Repeated large server readings could fill a pending raw-input envelope before final report
independentFixes.resolution: Bound per-step reads and reserve remaining report overhead; retain earlier observations and mark the new reading unavailable on evidence-size limit instead of stranding the lease.
